Class Area

java.lang.Object
es.upm.dit.aled.lab5.Area
public class Area extends Object
Models an area in a hospital ER. Each Area is characterized by its name (which must be unique), the time a patient must spend there to be treated (in milliseconds), the capacity (maximum number of patients that can be treated at the same time), the number of patients being treated at a given time, and the number of patients currently waiting. This class is a monitor that ensures that there is a thread safe way to enter and exit the area. Each Area is represented graphically by a square of side 120 px, centered in a given position and with a custom color.
Author:
rgarciacarmona

    • enter

      public void enter(es.upm.dit.aled.lab5.Patient p)
      Thread safe method that allows a Patient to enter the area. If the Area is currently full, the Patient thread must wait.
      Parameters:
      p - The patient that wants to enter.

    • exit

      public void exit(es.upm.dit.aled.lab5.Patient p)
      Thread safe method that allows a Patient to exit the area. After the Patient has left, this method notifys all waiting Patients.
      Parameters:
      p - The patient that wants to enter.
